confidence.official: read on the regulator's own site
confidence.secondary: well established; confirm details on the source
confidence.to_verify: likely applies; confirm with the regulator before relying on it

fssai.title: FSSAI registration or licence
fssai.text: Every food business needs FSSAI basic registration (up to ₹12 lakh turnover), a State licence, or a Central licence (above ₹20 crore). Apply on FoSCoS.

legal_metrology.title: Legal Metrology declarations
legal_metrology.text: Pre-packed goods must carry name and address, net quantity, MRP, date and customer-care details; packers may need registration.

tnpcb.title: TNPCB consent to establish and operate
tnpcb.text: Units with emissions or effluent need Consent to Establish and Consent to Operate from the Tamil Nadu Pollution Control Board, by the category of the industry.

zld.title: Zero liquid discharge for dyeing and bleaching
zld.text: Textile dyeing and bleaching units in Tamil Nadu operate under zero-liquid-discharge conditions set by the pollution board.

cdsco_md.title: Medical Devices Rules registration
cdsco_md.text: Medical devices are regulated by risk class (A–D) under the Medical Devices Rules, 2017: manufacturing licence from the state or CDSCO, and testing.

ayush.title: AYUSH manufacturing licence
ayush.text: Ayurveda, Siddha and Unani products need a manufacturing licence from the state AYUSH licensing authority and GMP compliance.

fco_cib.title: Biofertiliser and biopesticide registration
fco_cib.text: Biofertilisers fall under the Fertiliser Control Order; biopesticides need registration with the Central Insecticides Board.

bis.title: BIS certification for notified products
bis.text: Many electrical and electronic products are under compulsory BIS registration or ISI marking; check whether your product is notified.

cmvr.title: Type approval for vehicle conversions
cmvr.text: EV retrofit kits and vehicle modifications need type approval from a testing agency (such as ARAI or ICAT) under the Central Motor Vehicles Rules.

rbi_lending.title: Lending only through RBI-regulated entities
rbi_lending.text: Lending needs an RBI-regulated lender (bank or NBFC); a platform must follow RBI's digital lending directions and cannot lend from its own book without a licence.

dpdp.title: Digital Personal Data Protection Act
dpdp.text: Collecting personal data needs consent, purpose limits and security safeguards under the DPDP Act, 2023.

health_data.title: Health records and telemedicine rules
health_data.text: Telemedicine follows the Telemedicine Practice Guidelines; health data handling should align with ABDM standards.

gi_user.title: GI authorised user registration
gi_user.text: Selling under a geographical indication (such as Madurai Malli or Madurai Sungudi) needs registration as an authorised user with the GI Registry.

apeda.title: APEDA registration for agri exports
apeda.text: Exporters of scheduled agricultural and processed food products need APEDA registration-cum-membership.

tea_board.title: Tea Board registration
tea_board.text: Businesses that buy, blend or pack tea may need Tea Board registration; confirm whether your activity is covered.

solar_almm.title: Approved solar modules for subsidised schemes
solar_almm.text: Government-subsidised solar projects generally require modules from MNRE's approved list (ALMM).

electrical_safety.title: Electrical installation approval
electrical_safety.text: Electrical installations above set voltages need approval from the Electrical Inspectorate.

plastic_ban.title: Tamil Nadu ban on single-use plastics
plastic_ban.text: Tamil Nadu bans specified single-use plastic items; alternatives must not contain plastic lining to qualify.

cea_metering.title: Metering standards
cea_metering.text: Meters connected to the grid must meet CEA metering regulations and utility approval.

dgca_drone.title: Drone rules
dgca_drone.text: Drones need type certification and registration on Digital Sky under the Drone Rules, 2021.

bmw.title: Biomedical waste rules
bmw.text: Handling, transport and treatment of biomedical waste follows the Bio-Medical Waste Management Rules, 2016, with authorisation from the pollution control board.

tn_clinical.title: Clinical establishment registration
tn_clinical.text: Clinics, labs and collection centres in Tamil Nadu register under the state's Clinical Establishments (Regulation) Act and rules.

cosmetics.title: Cosmetics manufacturing licence
cosmetics.text: Making cosmetics needs a manufacturing licence under the Cosmetics Rules, 2020, from the state licensing authority.

ewaste.title: E-waste producer responsibility
ewaste.text: Producers and refurbishers of listed electrical and electronic equipment register on the CPCB portal under the E-Waste (Management) Rules, 2022.

plastic_epr.title: Plastic packaging producer responsibility
plastic_epr.text: Producers, importers, brand owners and recyclers of plastic packaging register for extended producer responsibility under the Plastic Waste Management Rules.

swm.title: Solid waste management rules
swm.text: Collection and processing of municipal solid waste follows the Solid Waste Management Rules, 2016, usually under contract with the local body.

chit_funds.title: Chit fund registration
chit_funds.text: Chit businesses register with the state Registrar of Chits under the Chit Funds Act, 1982; a technology platform must partner with a registered chit company.

irdai.title: Insurance distribution licence
irdai.text: Selling insurance needs an IRDAI licence or registration (broker, corporate agent, or point-of-sales persons under an insurer or intermediary).

transport_permit.title: Vehicle permits
transport_permit.text: Commercial passenger and goods vehicles need permits and registration from the Transport Department; electric vehicles have specific permit relaxations — confirm current rules.

edu_board.title: School board and education rules
edu_board.text: Content and tools used inside schools are adopted through school managements or the education department; children's data needs verifiable parental consent under the DPDP Act.

drug_licence.title: Drug licence for selling medicines
drug_licence.text: Retail and wholesale sale of medicines needs a drug licence from the Tamil Nadu Drugs Control Department under the Drugs and Cosmetics Rules, with a registered pharmacist on site.

nabl.title: NABL accreditation for testing labs
nabl.text: Accreditation is voluntary but most buyers, exporters and regulators accept only results from NABL-accredited labs.

iec_export.title: Import Export Code (IEC)
iec_export.text: Anyone importing or exporting needs an Import Export Code from DGFT; product export councils add registration (RCMC) for export benefits.

bis_hallmark.title: BIS hallmarking for gold jewellery
bis_hallmark.text: Gold jewellery sold in notified districts must carry a BIS hallmark with a unique ID, and jewellers must register with BIS.

rera.title: TNRERA registration for projects and agents
rera.text: Real-estate projects above the set size, and the agents who sell them, register with the Tamil Nadu Real Estate Regulatory Authority.
